description: ADO-PARAM value conversion into one Integer input parameter of 'SELECT ID FROM T WHERE L = ?': for each value tag (Long 20, Integer 20, Byte 20, String "20", Double 20.0, Double 20.5, Single 20, Boolean True, Currency 20, Date 20.0, String "2e1", " 20 ", "0x14", "", "abc", Null, Empty, a one-byte array) assign Parameters value, read it back, Execute, read all rows and the Errors (cleared).
